create_PagePreprocessingOptions: create a PagePreprocessingOptions instance with an optional images_scale float value
build_PagePreprocessingModel: build a PagePreprocessingModel instance configured with PagePreprocessingOptions for page image preprocessing
run_PagePreprocessingModel_call: run the PagePreprocessingModel to populate page images and parse page cells from a conversion result
test_rate_text_quality: test the rate_text_quality method to score PDF text cell quality by detecting garbage patterns like GLYPH tags and slash sequences
review_populate_page_images: review the _populate_page_images method that generates and caches page images at a specified scale
